rationale: Mechanically near-equivalent to the archived "Funded Organizational Runway" — since oiadp/xsga × xsga/sale = oiadp/sale, jointly requiring high ranks on the first two legs simply selects very-high-margin firms, leaving the identical xsga/sale and (act−lct)/xsga legs to do the work.

The runway denominator is dominated in magnitude by xsga for most firms, so this collapses to a two-leg version of the archived "Funded Organizational Runway"/"Fixed-Charge Liquidity Runway" pair rather than adding a distinct economic commitment.

This is essentially the intersection of two already-tested archive signals ("Liquid Fixed-Charge Coverage" and "Fixed-Charge Liquidity Runway"), and its two coverage legs share the identical dp+xint denominator, so the added leg contributes little independent information.
This is the archived "Flexible-Cost Liquid Margin" with its financial-health leg swapped for another archived liquidity leg — precisely the cosmetic leg-substitution the reasoning claims to avoid.

The cleanest and most internally consistent of the batch, with dp as a shared capital-maintenance yardstick for both earnings and liquidity, but it is still the same MIN(profitability, coverage, coverage) template as the archive's "Capital-Productive Liquid Earnings" and "Liquid Fixed-Charge Coverage" and its oiadp/at and oiadp/dp legs are highly correlated.

A direct recombination that takes the archived "Funded Organizational Runway" and replaces its margin leg with the archived oibdp/(dp+xint) coverage leg, offering no new economic mechanism beyond the existing components.
